svg.title: A distant outlier can erase a small group
svg.desc: Values are [−0.1, 0.2, −0.3, 0.4, 8, 9, 10, 11]. With one absmax/7 scale of 11/7, the first four round to zero. With groups of four, their scale is 0.4/7 and they retain codes [−2, 4, −5, 7]. The second group uses 11/7. Metadata doubles from one to two FP16 scales.

g.text: first group codes [0, 0, 0, 0] → all values become 0
8 four-bit codes = 4 bytes; scales: 2 bytes → 4 bytes
